```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 -c "
import subprocess, re, os
blog_dir = 'content/english/blog'
results = []
for f in sorted(os.listdir(blog_dir)):
    if not f.endswith('.md') or f.startswith('_') or f.startswith('__'):
        continue
    path = os.path.join(blog_dir, f)
    with open(path) as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    draft = 'draft: true' in content[:500]
    r = subprocess.run(['node','scripts/runPython.mjs','scripts/voice-lint.py','score',path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    m = re.search(r'per100w=\s*([\d.]+)', r.stdout)
    score = float(m.group(1)) if m else 999
    results.append((score, 'draft' if draft else 'live', f))
results.sort(reverse=True)
for s,d,f in results:
    print(f'{s:5.2f} {d:5} {f}')
print(f'--- total: {len(results)} published-ish')
"
```

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 -c "
import subprocess, re, os
blog_dir = 'content/english/blog'
results = []
for f in sorted(os.listdir(blog_dir)):
    if not f.endswith('.md') or f.startswith('_'):
        continue
    path = os.path.join(blog_dir, f)
    with open(path) as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    draft = re.search(r'^draft:\s*true', content, re.M) is not None
    r = subprocess.run(['node','scripts/runPython.mjs','scripts/voice-lint.py','score',path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    m = re.search(r'per100w=\s*([\d.]+)', r.stdout)
    score = float(m.group(1)) if m else 999
    results.append((score, 'draft' if draft else 'live', f))
results.sort(reverse=True)
for s,d,f in results[:25]:
    print(f'{s:5.2f} {d:5} {f}')
print(f'--- total: {len(results)}')
"
```

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 << 'PY'
import re, os, yaml
from pathlib import Path

blog_dir = Path('content/english/blog')
conn_cats = {"Opinion", "Faith", "Family", "Games", "Sports"}
generic_openers = [
    r'^# .+\n\n[A-Z][^.]+\bis\b',  # definition-style
    r'In today',
    r'When it comes to',
    r'At its core',
    r'Here\'s everything',
]

issues = []
for path in sorted(blog_dir.glob('*.md')):
    if path.name.startswith('_'):
        continue
    text = path.read_text()
    if path.name.startswith('__interesting'):
        continue
    # parse frontmatter
    m = re.match(r'^---\n(.*?)\n---\n(.*)', text, re.S)
    if not m:
        continue
    fm, body = m.group(1), m.group(2)
    draft = re.search(r'^draft:\s*true', fm, re.M) is not None
    cats = re.findall(r'^categories:\s*\n((?:\s+-\s*.+\n)+)', fm, re.M)
    cat_set = set()
    if cats:
        cat_set = set(re.findall(r'-\s*"?([^"\n]+)"?', cats[0]))
    # first 400 chars of body (strip markdown headings for test)
    body_start = re.sub(r'^#.*\n', '', body, count=1).strip()[:400]
    has_i = bool(re.search(r'\b(I|I\'|my|My)\b', body_start))
    # connection: reader problem vs definition
    first_para = body_start.split('\n\n')[0] if body_start else ''
    word_count = len(body.split())
    
    post_issues = []
    if cat_set & conn_cats and not has_i:
        post_issues.append('no-first-person-opener')
    if re.search(r'^## Bottom line\s*$', body, re.M):
        post_issues.append('bottom-line-heading')
    if re.search(r'Expanded from|Idea captured from', body):
        post_issues.append('wiki-export-footer')
    if re.search(r'\b(users|one) (should|might|may)\b', body, re.I):
        post_issues.append('third-person-advice')
    if re.search(r'it is recommended|it\'s important to note', body, re.I):
        post_issues.append('passive-advice')
    # generic opener heuristics
    if first_para and not has_i and not path.name.startswith('__'):
        if re.match(r'^[A-Z][a-z]+ is (a|an|the)\b', first_para):
            post_issues.append('dictionary-opener')
    
    if post_issues:
        issues.append((path.name, 'draft' if draft else 'live', post_issues, round(len(body_start.split())/max(1,len(body_start.split()))*100)))

for name, status, pis, _ in sorted(issues, key=lambda x: (x[1]=='live', x[0])):
    print(f"{status:5} {name}: {', '.join(pis)}")

print(f"\nTotal with issues: {len(issues)}")
PY
```

````bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 << 'PY'
import subprocess, re
from pathlib import Path

blog_dir = Path('content/english/blog')
results = []
for f in sorted(blog_dir.glob('*.md')):
    if f.name == '_index.md' or f.name == '__interesting-facts-about-jorap.md':
        continue
    text = f.read_text()
    m = re.match(r'^---\n(.*?)\n---\n(.*)', text, re.S)
    if not m: continue
    fm, body = m.group(1), m.group(2)
    draft = re.search(r'^draft:\s*true', fm, re.M) is not None
    words = len(re.sub(r'```.*?```', '', body, flags=re.S).split())
    r = subprocess.run(['node','scripts/runPython.mjs','scripts/voice-lint.py','score',str(f)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    score_m = re.search(r'per100w=\s*([\d.]+)', r.stdout)
    score = float(score_m.group(1)) if score_m else 999
    # connection: first 400 body chars after title
    body_clean = re.sub(r'^#.*\n', '', body, count=1).strip()
    opener = body_clean[:400]
    has_i = bool(re.search(r"\b(I'|I\b|my\b|My\b)", opener))
    thin = words < 200
    results.append((score, draft, thin, has_i, words, f.name))
results.sort(reverse=True)
print('TOP SLOP (all blogs):')
for s,d,thin,hi,w,name in results[:20]:
    flags = []
    if d: flags.append('draft')
    if thin: flags.append(f'thin:{w}w')
    if not hi: flags.append('no-I-opener')
    print(f'{s:5.2f} {" ".join(flags):20} {name}')
print(f'\nLive posts: {sum(1 for r in results if not r[1])}')
print(f'Drafts: {sum(1 for r in results if r[1])}')
print(f'Thin drafts (<200w): {sum(1 for r in results if r[1] and r[2])}')
print(f'Live no-I opener: {[r[5] for r in results if not r[1] and not r[3]]}')
PY
````

```bash
import json, sys, re
from pathlib import Path

# inline sentence splitter from slop-score
def sentences(text):
    out = []
    for line in text.split('\n'):
        s = line.strip()
        if not s: continue
        s = re.sub(r'^\s*#{1,6}\s*', '', s)
        s = re.sub(r'^\s*(?:[-*+]|\d+[.)])\s+', '', s)
        if not s: continue
        parts = re.split(r'(?<=[.!?:])\s+(?=[A-Z0-9\"\'\-])', s)
        for part in parts:
            part = part.strip()
            if part: out.append(part)
    return out

def wc(t): return len(re.findall(r\"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9'\-/]*\", t))

raw = Path('content/english/blog/streamlining-games-and-sports.md').read_text()
body = raw[raw.find('\n---\n', 3)+5:]
body = re.sub(r'\`\`\`.*?\`\`\`', ' ', body, flags=re.S)
for s in sentences(body):
    n = wc(s)
    if n > 25:
        print(f'{n:3d} | {s}')
"
```

Line-based splitting does not solve the problem. The scorer splits each line by period first, then by line. Bold markers at the start of a line still block the period split. Multiple sentences on one line therefore merge into a single long chunk.

Restructuring sentences so bold text appears inside rather than at the start would let the period split work correctly. Placing one sentence per line makes the period split work correctly. Each line becomes a single sentence unit, so bold markers no longer block the split. The fix is to use one sentence per line for catalog and rattle sections, and to split any genuinely long single sentences.
